events.title: SCCN Local Cyber Business Symposium
events.description:
The Local Cyber Business Symposium host by the SCCN is a community-driven event bringing together the businesses, universities, students and people building cyber capability right here on the Coast. No fly-in vendors, no big-city gloss — just local organisations showing what they do, how they operate, and why the region's ecosystem is worth backing.

 🎟️ Free entry — students, guests and vendors all welcome

The day runs across two sessions:
1:45–3:00pm — Students & Emerging Talent: cyber career pathways, industry insights and Q&A for uni/TAFE students and early-career folks.
3:30–6:00pm — Industry & Business Networks: local business showcases, presentations, facilitated discussion and open networking. Food platters and drinks from 5:00pm.

Local cyber & tech businesses — this is your platform. Exhibit a stall, take a 10–15 minute presentation slot, connect with the community and grow partnerships across industry and academia.

Proudly delivered through Innovation @ Altitude at Altitude Nine, with the support of Sunshine Coast Council, Sunshine Coast Regional Jobs Committee and Sun Con – Cyber Meets Surf.
events.location: Altitude Nine, South Sea Islander Way, Maroochydore QLD 4558

events.title: Sunshine Coast Celebrates
events.description:
The Sunshine Coast's business community is coming together to wrap up the year in style!

Join us on Thursday, 10th December, from 6:00pm to 8:30pm at Your Mates Brewing, Warana, for a festive evening hosted by some of the region's Chambers of Commerce, Networks and Industry Groups.

This Christmas celebration is all about connection, community and giving back. Guests will enjoy:

A welcome drink on arrival + food included

Live entertainment to keep the festive vibes flowing

A Giving Tree supporting a range of local charities chosen by our Chambers, Networks, and Industry Groups

Come together with fellow business leaders, colleagues, and friends at one of the Sunshine Coast's favourite local venues to celebrate the year that was and raise a glass to the one ahead.

Sunshine Coast Celebrates – where community meets Christmas cheer.
